title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
slides: Reflection debuts Beam, but can it rival China's giants?
Beam is open-weight and runs on less compute.
It matches Chinese models on key benchmarks, but not all.
You can now run Beam locally on a single GPU.
Test Beam on your own data before switching.
thread_text:
1. Beam vs China's giants

Reflection just released Beam, an open-weight model that runs on far less compute. It matches top Chinese models on key benchmarks, but not all.

2. Run Beam on one GPU

You can now run Beam locally on a single GPU. No cloud needed, no data leaving your machine.

3. Benchmarks match, but not all

Beam holds its own on many tests, but falls short on some. That gap matters depending on your use case.

4. Test before you switch

Don't trust benchmarks alone. Run Beam on your own data before replacing your current model.

5. Your move: test Beam today

Grab a prompt you use daily. Run it through Beam locally. If it fails, you saved yourself a costly switch.
